name: Get a glowing, natural looking tan in half an hour
location.name: Skin City

name: No more UV damage and premature aging due to sun bathing or tanning booths.
location.name: Skin City

name: Our product is hypoallergenic and fragrance-free, so no worry of reactions or that tell-tale tanning scent.
location.name: Skin City

name: DHA-based sunless tanning has been recommended by The Skin Cancer Foundation, American Academy of Dermatology Association, Canadian Dermatology Association and the American Medical Association.
location.name: Skin City

name: What should I expect during my session
location.name: Skin City

name: Are there different shades to choose from
location.name: Skin City

name: What gives you the color in from the tan
location.name: Skin City

name: Shower, exfoliate and shave before your session, preferably the night before.
location.name: Skin City

name: Shaving, waxing prior to your session ensures that you won't have to remove hair following your tan, which removes layers of color in the process.
location.name: Skin City

name: Don't apply moisturizer, oils, lotions or perfumes the day of your tan.
location.name: Skin City

name: Avoid wearing anything tight or constricting to the session.
location.name: Skin City

name: Tanning solution can stain, so do not sit directly on leather or fabric seats or furniture
location.name: Skin City

name: Avoid sweating and perspiring and be careful when washing hands until after the first shower following your tan.
location.name: Skin City

name: Shower 5-8 hours following your tan, and use shower gel to cleanse with your hands (washcloths, etc are too exfoliating).
location.name: Skin City

name: Moisturize twice a day with alcohol-free lotion.
location.name: Skin City

name: Soaking in a bath or hot tub or pool can accelerate exfoliating and fade a tan.
location.name: Skin City

name: Make sure you shower and wash your hair in the AM, as you will need to avoid showering for 24 hours after to allow lashes to fully dry.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not use waterproof mascara or eye make up.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not use any oily skin care products near your eyes. This includes eye creams, serums and moisturizers.
location.name: Skin City

name: If your natural lashes are light, they will need to be tinted prior to your service so they will match the lash extensions.
location.name: Skin City

name: If you are wearing lashes applied by another salon, it is best to let most, if not all of them shed prior to booking a lash appointment.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not wet your eyelashes for 24 hours after your procedure.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not use waterproof mascara on your eyelashes.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not use cotton swabs to remove makeup around the eyelashes. Cotton can get trapped between lashes.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not use cleansers, makeup removers or moisturizers that contain oil or solvents on your eyes, as these will compromise the bonding agent used to adhere your eyelashes.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not rub your eyes. Instead, you should get used to patting your eyes gently-which is, in fact, much better for the eyelashes and the sensitive skin around the eyes.
location.name: Skin City

name: Be careful not to get your eyelashes caught on clothes when you're dressing and undressing or towels when you've showered.
location.name: Skin City

name: Never pull your eyelash extension off as it will pull out your natural eyelash.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not perm or tint your eyelash extensions.
location.name: Skin City

name: Do not use eyelash curlers on your eyelashes.
location.name: Skin City

name: Book your next eyelash refill at 2 weeks - a maximum of 3 week intervals in order to maintain your optimum eyelash effect.
location.name: Skin City

name: After the first 48 hours, wash your lashes daily by rinsing with room temp water.
location.name: Skin City

name: Comb through your lashes daily. (we will provide you with a lash brush)
location.name: Skin City

name: Do use a sealant every 2-3 days to protect the bond of the extension
location.name: Skin City

name: Do use lash enhancement serum daily to protect the integrity of your natural lashes.
location.name: Skin City

name: There are specific instructions to be followed after your skin peel - this is as important as the peel itself.
location.name: Skin City

name: When the skin peel is completed and your professional has determined the skin is healed, daily skin care is essential.
location.name: Skin City

location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: 'My dad was allergic to anything with fur,' she recounts, 'so I was the neighborhood kid who walked everyone's dog for free.'
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: Living for five years on a boat in the Berkeley Marina, she found 'a couple dozen' who had been abandoned there.

name: Now, Doggy Lama boasts a diverse group of walkers, including a professional dog trainer

name: A few of her canine clients split their time between divorced 'parents,'
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: It may be Kenefick's exuberance and energy that sets her apart and keeps her business growing.

name: Kenefick comfortably embraces the minimalist title of 'dog walker' but sees herself as more of a pet specialist after years of service to East Bay animals and their families.
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: She says that the small number of boarding dogs and home settings 'ensure that they are truly treated like part of the family during their stay.'
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: Finally, the team offers daily drop-in visits for pets whose guardians can't be home during the day.
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: 'Chickens are getting really big,' she chuckles.
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: Kenefick strives to support her human clients in making life more rewarding for the animals they love.
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: 'I think of myself as a doggy aunt,' she says. 'I can spoil them in ways that their parents may not always have the time or energy to do.'
location.name: Doggy Lama Pet Care

name: In exchange, Kenefick says she learns from animals the importance of mindful attention to the present moment.
